reason: The core is free, so I would just download it and let my son try the free part. I will not pay for PRO until other mothers in the kindergarten group say their child really learned letters from it.
objection: Will my child actually learn, or just play? Many apps say 'learning' and the child only taps on the cartoons. Nobody I know has used this one yet.
would_change_my_mind: Several mothers in our kindergarten Telegram group, or the teacher, saying their child learned the Uzbek letters with it and is reading better.
